input: Existing verified v21 forced-vs-hold and below-entry rule event ledgers, no new market data
decision: Forced sale of remaining position versus original hold; context has unchanged hard stop and partial profit, next-open theoretical OHLC fill
beneficial_decision: Actual next-open forced early exit yields strictly higher *modeled net trade return* than holding
harmful_decision: Forced early exit yields strictly lower modeled net trade return than holding
theoretical_break_even_precision: Mean harm among harmful forced exits divided by (mean harm among harmful + mean benefit among beneficial), strictly positive observed changes only. This is a descriptive break-even classifier precision under observed payoff magnitudes, NOT future probability.
naive_signal_precision: Fraction of below-entry triggered decisions that were economically beneficial vs harmful; zero deltas tracked separately.
primary: Asymmetry in economic payoff of mistakes; include concentration and stop-unavailable fractions; no threshold fitting
additional: Leave-one-entry-week-out range in break-even precision for eligible forced-exit comparisons; keep correlated assets grouped
